conventions.name: Project Wiki
conventions.description: Maintain a .wiki/ of durable codebase knowledge (gotchas, decisions, glossary) in this project's tree.

conventions.name: Orchestrator Wiki
conventions.description: Maintain the conductor's machine-local .conduct/wiki/ of global, per-workspace and per-project conducting knowledge.

tools.name: read_index
tools.description: Read the conductor wiki's index pages for a set of scopes. Always returns the wiki root index and global/index.md; `project` and `workspace` each add their own index, and `project` additionally resolves which workspace that project belongs to and adds that workspace's index. Overlapping scopes are deduped. A scope with no page yet is reported in meta.missing — that is a normal answer, not a failure. Emits a compact-JSON meta block followed by one separate raw text block per scope. Start wiki recall here, then read the pages the returned indexes point to.

project.description: Project whose projects/<name>/index.md to include, plus the index of the workspace it belongs to.

workspace.description: Workspace whose workspaces/<name>/index.md to include. Use when reading across a workspace without naming one of its projects.
